# Abeta KMP Kit

> Open-source Server-Driven UI (SDUI) monorepo pairing a 4-layer Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform UI, Wearable & Local Database Kit (`kmp/`, 11 publishable library modules with native Android `.aar` targets via AGP `9.5.3` + Gradle BOM `io.github.abeta-dev:bom:0.8.0` + Version Catalog = 13 Maven Central artifacts) with a Go 1.26.0 Clean Architecture SDUI BFF (`bff/` — `bff@v0.9.0`, 8 exportable `pkg/sdui/*` packages), sharing a 1:1 `v1` JSON wire protocol (29 Wire Atoms, 31 Stateless Compose UI Atoms, 23 Canonical SnippetTypes incl. `composed_block` Atomic Snippet Molding Engine with 36 `ComposedNodeKind`s, `custom_slot`, and `graph_canvas`, 18 ActionTypes, 6 `SnippetDeltaOp`s, 7 Ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s, 11 Golden JSON fixtures) across `android` (`.aar`, `compileSdk = 37`, `minSdk = 24`), `jvm`, `ios*`, `macosArm64`, `watchos*`, and `wasmJs`.

`Abeta-dev/kmp` is the client kit and canonical `v1` wire-contract foundation of the 3-repo **Abeta SDUI Platform** alongside `Abeta-dev/layout-engine` and `Abeta-dev/sdui-bff`. Every module enforces the Uncle Bob Dependency Rule (`Layer 3 -> Layer 2 -> Layer 1 -> Layer 0`; Go `handler -> usecase -> domain <- infra`), strict Atomic / Action decoupling, Binary Compatibility Validator ABI baselines, and 1:1 KMP <-> Go golden JSON parity.

## Mandatory Grounding Before Generation (6-Step Order)

Follow this fixed grounding sequence before proposing designs or writing code:
`AGENTS.md → Architecture Docs (docs/architecture.md) → Flow Docs (docs/flows/*.md) → Pattern Docs (docs/patterns/*.md) → CodeGraph Symbols (docs/codegraph/INDEX.md & symbols.json / ./scripts/generate_codegraph.py --query <symbol>) → Source Reads Only for Verification`

- [Flow Docs Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/flows/README.md): Stage 3 end-to-end runtime flow guides (screen load/cache/manifest, action dispatch & offline sync, SSE delta streaming, wearable & Apple/Android hosts).
- [Pattern Docs Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/patterns/README.md): Stage 4 canonical implementation recipes (atoms & snippets, OCP actions & OS bridges, Go BFF cache/server, KMP HMPP/ABI/Room 3).
- [CodeGraph Symbol Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/codegraph/INDEX.md): Stage 5 deterministic Kotlin/Go/Swift module graph and public symbol `file:line` anchor index (`docs/codegraph/README.md`, `docs/codegraph/symbols.json`, queried via `./scripts/generate_codegraph.py --query <symbol>`).

## Complete Reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/llms-full.txt): Self-contained LLM-ready technical reference covering the 6-step Mandatory Grounding protocol, 3-repo Abeta SDUI Platform, 4-layer architecture, all 11 publishable KMP modules (`io.github.abeta-dev:bom:0.8.0` incl. native `-android` `.aar` targets), Room 3 database (schema v2 w/ `MIGRATION_1_2` & `DatabaseKeyValueStore`), deferred OS ports (`macosMain` AppKit `DesktopSystemPort`, real `FilePickerPort`, `AudioCapturePort`, `LocationPort`), SDUI Wire Protocol v1 (29 Wire Atoms, 31 Stateless Compose UI Atoms, 23 SnippetTypes, 18 ActionTypes, 6 `SnippetDeltaOp`s, 7 Ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s, 11 golden fixtures), installation snippets (`bff@v0.9.0`, 4-product SwiftPM `Abeta-dev/kmp-spm` `0.8.0`), 7-in-1 Super-App Showcase, 20-story End-to-End Storybook, and verification commands.

## Core Documentation

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/README.md): Repository overview, architecture diagram, module matrix, Gradle BOM quick start, AI Grounding & CodeGraph, and CLI commands.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/AGENTS.md): Authoritative AI coding agent contract, Section 0 Mandatory Grounding protocol, skill & code-owner routing table, architectural truth gates, and verification commands.
- [Architecture & Uncle Bob Dependency Rule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/architecture.md): Layer 0–3 dependency graph, native Android `.aar` target matrix, `DatabaseKeyValueStore`, deferred OS ports, import isolation rules, Go Clean Architecture boundaries, and OCP extension points.
- [SDUI Wire Protocol (v1)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/sdui-wire-protocol.md): HTTP `ginmw.Envelope` / `BffEnvelope<T>`, `PageResponse`, `ScreenManifestResponse`, `SnippetDeltaPatch` (6 ops), `AdaptivePageSpec`, `FloatingCartSpec`, `MotionSpec`, 29 wire atoms, 23 snippet payloads, 18 actions, and 11 golden JSON fixtures.
- [Atomic & Action Separation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/atomic-and-action-separation.md): Strict decoupling between stateless Layer 1 Compose atoms (`ui-atoms`) and Layer 2 OCP action execution (`action-engine`).
- [Gradle BOM & Version Catalog Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/gradle-bom-guide.md): Using `io.github.abeta-dev:bom:0.8.0`, `io.github.abeta-dev:dependencies:0.8.0`, native `*-android` `.aar` artifacts, BCV `api/jvm/<mod>.api`, `libs.versions.toml`, `internal.versions.toml`, and `abeta.kmpLocalBuild` substitution.
- [Multiplatform Local Database Guide (Room 3 + SQLite)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/local-database-room3.md): Layer 0 Room 3 (`3.0.3`, schema v2 w/ `MIGRATION_1_2`) KMP persistence (`cached_screens`, `offline_mutations`, `key_value_records`), `DatabaseKeyValueStore`, native `androidMain` Room 3 driver + `AbetaAndroidContext.initialize(context)`, `sqlite-bundled:2.7.1`, `sqlite-web:2.7.1` OPFS Web Worker, and KSP (`2.3.14`) `@ConstructedBy` codegen.
- [Open Package Hosting & Release Publishing Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/publishing-and-hosting.md): Zero-credential consumption and automated publishing across Maven Central (`io.github.abeta-dev:*:0.8.0` incl. `*-android` `.aar`s, `vars.ENABLE_MAVEN_CENTRAL=true`), Cloudsmith Open Source, 4-product Apple SwiftPM (`Abeta-dev/kmp-spm` `0.8.0`: `AbetaSduiKit`, `AbetaWatchKit`, `AbetaSduiSwiftUI`, `AbetaWatchSwiftUI`), and Go `proxy.golang.org` (`bff@v0.9.0`).
- [Go BFF Integration Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/bff-integration.md): Go 1.26.0 SDUI BFF (`github.com/abeta-dev/kmp/bff@v0.9.0`), 8 exportable `pkg/sdui/*` packages (`cache`, `server`, `molecules`, `analytics`, etc.), 12 built-in screens, SSE delta streams, OpenAPI 3.1, and Scalar UI.
- [Visual Showcase — Demo App & Storybook Screenshots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/demo-screenshots.md): Pixel-accurate Compose Multiplatform Retina PNG captures for the 7-in-1 Super-App Showcase, core reference screens, and 20-story Storybook.
- [Per-Module Code Owners & Automated CI/CD Governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/module-owners-and-cicd.md): Mapping of all 17 Code Owner agents, `.github/CODEOWNERS`, architecture checks, ABI gates, and release pipelines.
- [IDE & Multi-Model AI Setup Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/docs/ide-and-ai-setup.md): Configuration for Claude Code, Gemini/Antigravity, Cursor, Android Studio/Junie, and GitHub Copilot/Codex plus the 6-step Mandatory Grounding workflow.

## Ecosystem Sibling Repositories

- [Abeta Layout Engine (llms.txt)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/llms.txt): Companion SDUI layout & composition engine in the 3-repo Abeta SDUI Platform.
- [Abeta SDUI BFF (llms.txt)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/sdui-bff/main/llms.txt): Multi-tenant production Go SDUI BFF serving the 7-in-1 Super-App Showcase over `github.com/abeta-dev/kmp/bff@v0.9.0` Wire Protocol v1.

## AI Agent Skills

- [abeta-kmp-demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-demo/SKILL.md): Reference guide for `sample-app` (7-in-1 Super-App Showcase Launcher), 20-story End-to-End `storybook` (incl. Live 7-in-1 Browser Demos, All 23 Snippets, & 8 UI Atom stories covering all 31 atoms), and BFF-to-KMP parity.
- [abeta-kmp-platforms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-platforms/SKILL.md): Android, Wear OS, iOS/iPadOS, watchOS, macOS, Desktop JVM, and WasmJS host wiring, Core OS/Voice/Desktop bridges, Room 3 drivers, and Apple HMPP split.
- [abeta-kmp-atomic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-atomic/SKILL.md): Authoring `design-tokens`, responsive metrics, pure `sdui-contracts` DTOs, and stateless `ui-atoms` without outer-layer leaks.
- [abeta-kmp-actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-actions/SKILL.md): Implementing OCP action decoders, handlers, OS bridge outcomes, and `DefaultActionDispatcher` in `action-engine`.
- [abeta-kmp-bff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-bff/SKILL.md): Building and testing Go 1.26.0 SDUI BFF screens, `pkg/sdui/*` builders/cache/server packages, middleware, SSE streams, and 11 golden parity fixtures.
- [abeta-kmp-architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-architecture/SKILL.md): Auditing Clean Architecture, Uncle Bob Dependency Rule, SOLID/KISS, BOM/Catalog registration, and ABI checks.
- [abeta-kmp-module-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-module-review/SKILL.md): Per-module Code Owner PR review workflow mapping diffs to the 17 dedicated owner personas.
- [abeta-kmp-cicd](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/skills/abeta-kmp-cicd/SKILL.md): GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, ABI/brand/secret security gates, 4-product SwiftPM packaging, and SemVer releases.

## Module Code Owners

- [core-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/core-owner.md): Layer 0 primitives, `AppResult`/`AppError`, concurrency utilities, and multi-OS hardware/voice/desktop/security bridges (`kmp/core`).
- [state-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/state-owner.md): Layer 0 `SessionStore`, `DataStoreKeyValueStore`, `createDiskKeyValueStore`, `PreferenceStore`, secure persistent KV store, `FeatureFlagProvider`, and `OfflineMutationQueue` (`kmp/state`).
- [analytics-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/analytics-owner.md): Layer 0 `AnalyticsTracker` pipeline, sanitizing, deduplicating, enriching, and buffered trackers (`kmp/analytics`).
- [database-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/database-owner.md): Layer 0 Room 3 (`3.0.3`, schema v2 w/ `MIGRATION_1_2`) KMP SQLite database, `DatabaseKeyValueStore`, native `androidMain` builder, DAOs, schema exports, and Bundled/Web OPFS drivers (`kmp/database`).
- [design-tokens-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/design-tokens-owner.md): Layer 1 semantic colors, typography, spacing, motion, theme presets, WCAG contrast, and `ResponsiveTokens` (`kmp/design-tokens`).
- [sdui-contracts-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/sdui-contracts-owner.md): Layer 1 pure `@Serializable` v1 wire DTOs, 29 wire atoms, 23 snippet contracts (incl. `nudge_bar`, `marquee_strip`, `order_tracker`, `composed_block` with 36 `ComposedNodeKind`s, `custom_slot`, `graph_canvas`), 6 `SnippetDeltaOp`s, 7 ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s, `FloatingCartSpec` threshold nudges, and `AdaptiveContracts` (`kmp/sdui-contracts`).
- [ui-atoms-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/ui-atoms-owner.md): Layer 1 31 stateless Compose Multiplatform atoms (incl. `UiMediaPager`, ISO/IEC 18004 `UiQrCode`, `UiRadioGroup`, `UiSelect`, `UiOtpInput`, `UiChip`, `UiSegmentedControl`, `UiRating`, `UiPrice`, `UiBadge`, `UiAlertBanner`, `UiStatTile`, `UiKeyValueRow`, `UiCountdown`, `UiRollingCounter`), `UiCelebrationOverlay`, `UiHapticFeedback`, 7 ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s, and `Modifier.pressBounce`/`shakeOnError` (`kmp/ui-atoms`).
- [action-engine-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/action-engine-owner.md): Layer 2 OCP action decoders, handlers, 18 built-in `ActionTypes`, validator, and `DefaultActionDispatcher` (`kmp/action-engine`).
- [network-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/network-owner.md): Layer 2 Ktor 3.6.1 HTTP/2 ALPN + Brotli client, conditional `304`, SSE `KtorSseTransport`, CSRF `403` retry, bearer refresh, and JVM/Apple SPKI `CertificatePinMatcher` (`kmp/network`).
- [sdui-layout-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/sdui-layout-owner.md): Layer 3 `LayoutController`, 23 snippet renderers (incl. `ComposedBlock` w/ 36 `ComposedNodeKind`s, `CustomSlot`, `GraphCanvas`), SSE delta patching, `FloatingCartDockHost`, `CachedScreenRepository` (`VERSION_GATED`), `RemoteBffAnalyticsTracker`, `PlatformBridgeBundle`, Koin, iOS/macOS hosts (`kmp/sdui-layout`).
- [watch-companion-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/watch-companion-owner.md): Layer 3 headless wearable SDUI companion for watchOS (`AbetaWatchKit.xcframework`) and Wear OS (`kmp/watch-companion`).
- [platforms-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/platforms-owner.md): Layer 3 drop-in native host glue templates for Android, Wear OS (`WearSduiRenderer.kt`), Apple SwiftUI/SwiftPM (`AbetaSduiSwiftUI`, `AbetaWatchSwiftUI`), and Web COOP/COEP (`kmp/platforms`).
- [bom-catalog-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/bom-catalog-owner.md): Gradle BOM (`io.github.abeta-dev:bom:0.8.0`), Version Catalog (`io.github.abeta-dev:dependencies:0.8.0`), and `kmpLocalBuild` substitution (`kmp/kmp-bom`, `kmp/dependencyManagement`).
- [bff-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/bff-owner.md): Go 1.26.0 Clean Architecture SDUI BFF, 8 `pkg/sdui/*` packages (`bff@v0.9.0`), 12 built-in screens, OpenAPI 3.1, SSE streams, and 11 golden parity fixtures (`bff/`).
- [sample-app-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/sample-app-owner.md): Layer 3 runnable Compose Desktop & `--headless`/`--verticals` CLI 7-in-1 Super-App Showcase Launcher (`kmp/sample-app`).
- [storybook-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/storybook-owner.md): Layer 3 interactive 20-story Compose Multiplatform Storybook (8 UI Atom stories covering all 31 atoms, All 23 Snippets, Live 7-in-1 Super-App Demos, Animation & Nudges Lab, Atomic Snippet Crafter, Voice & Desktop OS Bridges, End-to-End App Journeys) for Desktop, WasmJS, macOS, and iOS (`kmp/storybook`).
- [cicd-platform-owner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/agents/owners/cicd-platform-owner.md): GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, verification scripts, ABI/hygiene gates, and multi-channel release automation (`.github/`, `scripts/`).
